prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose your journey and bring a smart, living pet right onto your desktop screen."]
1: ["Protect Your Pet Across Devices", "Signing in backs up your pet memory and personality traits so your companion never gets lost or reset.", "Continue to Sign In"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion", "Swipe or click to view pet personalities"]
3: ["Confirm Desktop Overlay Permissions", "Checking screen permissions to ensure your pet floats cleanly over active windows.", "Desktop Permission Granted"]
4: ["Your Desktop Pet Is Live!", "Right-click your pet on screen to open chat, access options, or hide them to system tray."]
5: ["Sign In to Save & Restore Pets", "Use your primary account so your pet's custom traits, stats, and memory sync automatically.", "Already created a pet? Sign in with your original account to bring them back."]
6: ["Tip: You can drag your pet anywhere on screen once loaded."]
7: ["Includes Free Starter Trait Pack"]
8: []
9: ["Look for the pet icon in your system tray to quickly show, hide, or mute your companion."]
